title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theatre on 1970-02-02
lineage: SBD > MR > R > R > PCM > DAT > CDR > EAC (secure) > Cool Edit (minor fixes) > CD Wave (retracking) > shntool > mkwACT > SHN (seekable)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a stellar 1970 St. Louis show highlighted by an epic Dark Star and fierce Mason's Children.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the soaring Dark Star, calling it one of the best after 2/13/70, and they appreciate the crisp, high‑quality soundboard source that brings out every nuance. The brief but ferocious Mason’s Children and a noted Pigpen moment in Lovelight add extra sparkle, while only a tiny glitch (“cut”) is mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: All but one review are 4‑5 stars and praise both the performance (especially Dark Star) and the high‑quality recording; the lone 0‑star appears to be an outlier.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe a "nice, high quality copy" with crystal‑clear sound; one reviewer notes a small cut in Mason's Children but overall the mix is clean and well balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show is centered around an extended, improvisational Dark Star that sets a high bar; the brief but intense Mason’s Children and the emotive Lovelight provide dynamic contrast.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work on Dark Star is described as beautiful and fiery.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s soulful contribution during Lovelight is highlighted in the liner‑note tribute.
